presets.name: Grand Piano
presets.description: Balanced grand piano resonance. Guitar sits forward with subtle sympathetic strings underneath.

presets.name: Upright Piano
presets.description: Tighter, more muted character. Less sustain, narrower body resonance.

presets.name: Concert Grand
presets.description: Full resonant concert grand. Wide stereo, long sustain, open strings.

presets.name: Prepared Piano
presets.description: Objects on strings. Muted, metallic, inharmonic. Overtones pushed forward.

presets.name: Ambient Sustain
presets.description: Long sustain drone pad. Pedal hold freezes pitch. Wet dominates.

presets.name: Subtle Resonance
presets.description: Barely audible — adds shimmer without being obvious. Good for clean playing.
